name: Mosaic Manticore
card_text: During the Standby Phase of your next turn after you Tribute Summoned this face-up card on the field: Special Summon, from the Graveyard, as many monster(s) as possible that were used for its Tribute Summon. They cannot declare an attack, and their effects are negated.
available_set: BATTLE PACK 2 WAR OF THE GIANTS
